title: 深谈中国的机器人革命内情(6)
desc: 深谈中国的机器人革命内情(6)

paragraphs.en: In China today, it often feels as if new technologies are becoming normalised far more quickly than elsewhere.
paragraphs.zh: 如今在中国，各类新技术落地普及的速度远超其他国家。

paragraphs.en: In the city of Chongqing, on Saturday nights, there are "drone shows" in which thousands of drones arrange themselves above the Yangtze River to form giant luminescent images in the sky: of cityscapes, flowers, animals.
paragraphs.zh: 重庆每到周六夜晚会举办无人机表演，数千架无人机在长江上空编队，在空中勾勒出巨型发光图案：城市风光、鲜花、各类动物造型应有尽有。

paragraphs.en: In Chengdu, cyclists who stray into motor lanes are admonished by humanoid traffic cops.
paragraphs.zh: 在成都，闯入机动车道的骑行者会被人形交通劝导机器人提醒纠正。

paragraphs.en: Commuters in Wuhan, Shenzhen and Beijing are hailing driverless taxis.
paragraphs.zh: 武汉、深圳、北京的市民已经可以呼叫无人驾驶出租车出行。

paragraphs.en: Part of the reason for this extensive rollout is simply that technology is cheaper to deploy.
paragraphs.zh: 新技术大范围落地，一部分原因是相关设备部署成本更低。

paragraphs.en: But it is also the result of a coordinated effort.
paragraphs.zh: 同时这也是多方统筹推进的成果。

paragraphs.en: During my visits to robotics startups, I often bumped into mid-level officials from cities such as Shenzhen and Hefei.
paragraphs.zh: 走访各家机器人初创企业期间，我经常碰到来自深圳、合肥等城市的中层政府工作人员。

paragraphs.en: They sat in meeting rooms listening attentively to engineers half their age.
paragraphs.zh: 他们坐在会议室里，认真聆听年纪仅为自己一半的工程师发言。

paragraphs.en: They aim to entice startups back to their localities, to raise them into local champions that attract talent and jobs.
paragraphs.zh: 各地政府希望吸引初创企业落地本地，将其培育成行业龙头，以此吸纳人才、创造就业岗位。

paragraphs.en: The Leju facility – more than 10,000 sq metres of factory space inside an industrial park – had been provided to the company by the district government, as part of a joint venture agreement, just two months before my visit.
paragraphs.zh: 乐聚这处一万多平方米的园区厂房，是区政府在我到访前两个月，按照合作协议免费提供给企业使用的。

paragraphs.en: Viktor Wang, co-founder of PsiBot, a startup that specialises in making dexterous robotic hands, told me he had received multiple unsolicited offers from municipal governments eager to help him establish training centres.
paragraphs.zh: 灵巧机械手研发企业PsiBot联合创始人王维克告诉我，已有多个城市政府主动向他抛出橄榄枝，愿意协助其建设实训基地。

paragraphs.en: "It's not just Beijing – Suzhou, Shanghai, Wuhan, everyone is willing to put money behind these [robotics] projects," he said.
paragraphs.zh: “不只是北京，苏州、上海、武汉各地都愿意为机器人项目投入资金。”他说道。

paragraphs.en: The competition is intense. Each city acts like a patron in the Hunger Games, backing their own tribute.
paragraphs.zh: 城市间的产业竞争十分激烈，各地如同竞技赛事的支持者，大力扶持本土机器人企业。

paragraphs.en: Hangzhou has Unitree. Shanghai has AgiBot. Beijing has Galbot. Shenzhen has UBTech.
paragraphs.zh: 杭州有宇树科技，上海有爱智机器人，北京有嘉博特，深圳有优必选。

paragraphs.en: A day after my visit to Leju, Wang invited me to try out a teleoperation sequence at his Beijing offices.
paragraphs.zh: 参观完乐聚的次日，王维克邀请我前往其北京办公室体验远程操控机器人作业流程。

paragraphs.en: The task was to pick up clothes from a pile and drop them into a bin.
paragraphs.zh: 任务是从一堆衣物中分拣衣物并投入收纳箱。

paragraphs.en: PsiBot has been in talks with the fast-fashion retailer Shein to replace workers performing the most basic tasks on the garment line, and Wang told me he thinks he can achieve this by September.
paragraphs.zh: PsiBot正与快时尚品牌希音洽谈合作，计划用机器人替代服装生产线基础岗位工人，王维克称有望在今年九月实现落地。

paragraphs.en: I put on skeletal gloves with Velcro straps linked electronically to a humanoid's hands positioned beside me.
paragraphs.zh: 我戴上带魔术贴的体感骨架手套，手套通过电子线路连接身旁人形机器人的手部。

paragraphs.en: The connection between my hand and the machine was not as smooth as I was expecting: it felt clunky, like operating the claw machine in an arcade.
paragraphs.zh: 手部设备与机器人的联动流畅度不及预期，操作起来十分生硬，如同电玩城抓娃娃机。

paragraphs.en: As I tried to grab the clothes with my robot hands, my mind half-expected to feel some tactile resistance.
paragraphs.zh: 我操控机械爪抓取衣物时，内心下意识期待能感受到真实的触感阻力。

paragraphs.en: It took me several tries to get the machine to do the required motion.
paragraphs.zh: 我反复尝试多次，才让机器人完成标准抓取动作。

paragraphs.en: Teleoperating, I realised, is not simply a matter of performing human actions that the robot learns.
paragraphs.zh: 我这时意识到，远程操控不只是单纯完成人类动作供机器人学习。

paragraphs.en: When you're doing a sequence, you must move at a speed that the machine can register.
paragraphs.zh: 整套操作流程中，操作人员的动作速度必须适配设备的数据采集速率。

paragraphs.en: You must keep your arms in a set position throughout.
paragraphs.zh: 全程手臂要保持固定姿态。

paragraphs.en: You cannot do normal human things such as scratch an itch. (Doing so would "pollute" the data.)
paragraphs.zh: 不能做出挠痒这类人类日常小动作，否则会造成数据污染。

paragraphs.en: The process was more physically taxing and stranger than I expected.
paragraphs.zh: 整套操作流程的体力消耗与怪异感超出我的预想。

paragraphs.en: We are training our robots to be more like humans; doing so requires that humans act more like robots.
paragraphs.zh: 我们努力训练机器人模仿人类，而实现这一目标，却需要人类像机器一样刻板行动。
